questions.q: In which city is the **Sagrada Família**?
How many faces are carved into **Mount Rushmore**?
The **Leaning Tower** of Pisa was built as a…?

lines.q: In which city is the Sagrada Familia?

lines.a: England! Out on Salisbury Plain, in Wiltshire.

lines.q: How many presidents' faces are carved into Mount Rushmore?
lines.a: Four! Washington, Jefferson, Theodore Roosevelt and Lincoln.

lines.q: The Leaning Tower of Pisa was built as a what?
lines.a: A bell tower! For the cathedral next door. It started leaning while they were still building it.

lines.q: In which city is the Acropolis?
lines.a: Athens! With the Parthenon sitting right on top.

lines.q: Last one. Neuschwanstein Castle is in which country?
lines.a: Germany! Up in the Bavarian Alps. It helped inspire Disney's Sleeping Beauty castle. Follow if you got all six!
